name: hostturn
description: FIG-7453: RLM host with 31 tools across 11 roots and a full owner-options catalogue on every turn. One setup turn then three quiet turns. Root/provider and run-option geometry follows Figments 083899321; schemas and tool distribution are synthetic. Vary host.tools, host.schema_fields and host.package_roots for scaling. Prompt limits match Figments at 128 KiB per section and 512 KiB total. Every turn carries a fresh authority binding and per-tool turn_id, matching run_authority.rs and ToolExecutionHandler::ChatTool.
